home.service_sale_desc: Imported high-end evening and wedding gowns

collection.title: The Collection
collection.subtitle: Evening gowns and wedding dresses — imported luxury

services.title: The Atelier
services.subtitle: Beyond the boutique — Élisheva designs, sews and refines every piece by hand
services.dressmaking_body: Every gown begins as a sketch — and ends as you. Élisheva designs and hand-sews made-to-measure dresses from carefully sourced French fabrics, blending Parisian tradition with the modest silhouettes our clients love. From the first fitting to the final stitch, your piece is one-of-one.
services.alterations_body: A dress should embrace you. Élisheva alters and refines garments — your own or a piece from the boutique — with the same care she brings to her bespoke work. Hems, taking in, letting out, sleeves, restoration of fine lace and beading. Drop by for a fitting; the atelier does the rest.
services.alterations_lead: The fit that makes everything work
services.alterations_steps: Same-week service · No appointment needed for first fitting · Pickup-ready in 5 to 10 days

classes.title: Sewing Classes
classes.subtitle: Learn to sew with Élisheva — classes for children and adults
classes.heroSub: Learn the craft with Élisheva — classes for both children and adults, six weeks of creativity, technique, and confidence
classes.childrenDesc: Perfect introduction to sewing. Students learn machine basics, hand-stitching, and create their first projects in a fun, encouraging environment.
classes.adultsDesc: Designed for all levels. Whether you're a complete beginner or returning to sewing, you'll learn core techniques and complete projects you'll love wearing.
classes.infoText: Classes are held year-round at the atelier in Tel Aviv. Enrol anytime, space is limited. Hours are flexible — contact us to arrange a time that works for you.
classes.curriculum: Machine operation, straight sewing, tote bag, zip, button-down skirt
